Discussion and analysis of 2023 and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 not included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K can be found in Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024. All statements in this section, other than statements of historical fact, are forward-looking statements that are inherently uncertain. See Disclosures Regarding Forward-Looking Statements and Item 1A. Risk Factors for a discussion of the factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from those projected in these statements. The following information concerning our business, results of operations and financial condition should also be read in conjunction with the information included under Item 1. Business, Item 1A. Risk Factors and Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data. MPLX OVERVIEW We are a diversified, large-cap MLP formed by MPC in 2012 that owns and operates midstream energy infrastructure and logistics assets, and provides fuels distribution services. Our assets include a network of crude oil and refined product pipelines; an inland marine business; light-product, asphalt, heavy oil and marine terminals; storage caverns; refinery tanks, docks, loading racks and associated piping; crude oil and natural gas gathering systems and pipelines; as well as natural gas and NGL processing and fractionation facilities. The business consists of two segments based on the product-based value chain each supports: Crude Oil and Products Logistics and Natural Gas and NGL Services . Our assets are positioned throughout the United States. The Crude Oil and Products Logistics segment primarily engages in the gathering, transportation, storage and distribution of crude oil, refined products, other hydrocarbon-based products and renewables. The Crude Oil and Products Logistics segment also includes the operation of our refining logistics, fuels distribution and inland marine businesses, terminals, rail facilities and storage caverns. The Natural Gas and NGL Services segment provides gathering, treating, processing and transportation of natural gas as well as the transportation, fractionation, storage and marketing of NGLs. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: You should carefully consider each of the following risks and all the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K in evaluating us and our common units. Although the risks are organized by headings, and each risk is discussed separately, many are interrelated. Our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows could be materially and adversely affected by these risks, and, as a result, the trading price of our common units could decline. We have in the past been adversely affected by certain of, and may in the future be affected by, these risks. Summary of Risk Factors We have in the past been adversely affected by certain of, and may in the future be adversely affected by, the following: • a significant decrease in crude oil and natural gas production in our areas of operation; • challenges in accurately estimating expected production volumes of our producer customers; 19 Table of Contents • our dependence on third parties for the crude oil, natural gas and refined products we gather, transport and store, the natural gas we process, and the NGLs we fractionate and stabilize at our facilities; • our ability to retain existing customers or acquire new customers; • our ability to increase fees enough to cover costs incurred under our gathering, treating, processing, transmission, transportation, fractionation, stabilization and storage agreements; • unplanned maintenance of the United States (“U.S.”) inland waterway infrastructure; • interruptions in operations at any of our facilities or those of our customers, including MPC; • inflation; • problems affecting our information technology systems and those of our third-party business partners and service providers; • business, compliance and reputational risks associated with increasing regulatory focus on data privacy issues, integrating artificial intelligence into our processes and expanding laws in those areas; • in our joint ventures, our lack of sole decision-making authority, our reliance on our joint venture partners’ financial condition and disputes between us and our joint venture partners; • terrorist attacks or other targeted operational disruptions aimed at our facilities or that impact our customers or the markets we serve; • increases to our maintenance or repair costs; • severe weather events, other climate conditions and earth movement and other geological hazards; • insufficient cash from operations after the establishment of cash reserves and payment of our expenses to enable us to pay the intended quarterly distribution to our unitholders; • our substantial debt and other financial obligations; • increases in interest rates; • our exposure to the credit risks of our key customers and derivative counterparties; • negative effects of our commodity derivative activities; • uninsured losses; • future costs relating to evolving environmental or other laws or regulations; • increased regulation of hydraulic fracturing; • climate-related and GHG emission regulation; • climate-related litigation; credit_strengths.text: MPLX's operating margin is exceptionally high, far exceeding the sector median, reflecting the fee-based nature of its midstream pipeline, terminal and processing assets. This structural cost advantage supports stable cash generation through commodity cycles and provides a strong buffer for debt service.

Operating cash flow covers interest expense multiple times, and free cash flow after capital expenditures remains substantial. This internally generated liquidity comfortably funds distributions and modest growth investments, reducing reliance on external financing for routine operations.

key_risks.text: MPLX's business depends on crude oil and natural gas production volumes in its areas of operation, and a significant decrease in production would reduce throughput and revenue. The risk factor passage explicitly highlights this exposure, along with challenges in estimating producer volumes and dependence on third parties for supply.

Debt maturities are concentrated in the near term, with a substantial portion due within the next twelve months and the following year. This refinancing requirement exposes MPLX to interest rate risk, especially given the risk factor's mention of increases in interest rates and substantial debt obligations.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is solid but sits below the sector median, indicating less headroom than peers. With operating income covering interest expense multiple times, debt service remains manageable, though the gap to sector norms suggests relative financial risk if earnings decline.

Free cash flow to debt is modest, and the ratio of cash flow to debt is below the sector median, placing MPLX in a lower tier for cash-flow-based leverage. This limits financial flexibility, particularly if capital expenditures rise or operating cash flow weakens.

overall_credit_view.text: MPLX's credit profile is supported by high-quality midstream infrastructure and strong operating margins, but leverage has increased notably over the past year, and cash-flow-based metrics lag sector medians. The indicative financial risk profile is significant, reflecting elevated debt relative to cash flow.

Analyst judgement: the combination of near-term maturities, substantial distributions and acquisitions absorbs most free cash flow, leaving limited cushion. While the business is resilient, the trajectory of debt and the absence of EBITDA data for leverage calculation warrant close monitoring of refinancing and capital allocation.

credit_strengths.text: MPLX的營運利潤率極高，遠超行業中位數，反映其中游管道、終端及加工資產以收費為主的性質。此結構性成本優勢支持其於商品週期中產生穩定現金流，並為償債提供強大緩衝。
營運現金流覆蓋利息支出數倍，且扣除資本開支後之自由現金流仍然可觀。此內部產生之流動性充裕地支持分派及適度增長投資，減少日常營運對外部融資之依賴。

key_risks.text: MPLX之業務依賴其營運地區之原油及天然氣產量，產量顯著下降將減少輸送量及收入。風險因素章節明確強調此風險敞口，以及估計生產商產量之挑戰及對第三方供應之依賴。
債務到期集中於短期，其中相當部分將於未來十二個月及隨後一年內到期。此再融資需求使MPLX面臨利率風險，尤其考慮到風險因素提及利率上升及巨額債務責任。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率穩健，但低於行業中位數，顯示緩衝空間較同業為少。營運收入覆蓋利息支出數倍，償債能力仍屬可控，惟與行業常規之差距意味若盈利下降，相對財務風險將上升。
自由現金流對債務比率適中，而現金流對債務比率低於行業中位數，使MPLX在基於現金流之槓桿方面處於較低層級。此限制財務靈活性，尤其若資本開支上升或營運現金流轉弱。

overall_credit_view.text: MPLX之信用狀況受惠於高質量中游基礎設施及強勁營運利潤率，但過去一年槓桿顯著上升，且基於現金流之指標落後於行業中位數。指示性財務風險狀況為顯著，反映債務相對於現金流偏高。
分析師判斷：短期到期債務、巨額分派及收購之組合吸收大部分自由現金流，緩衝有限。儘管業務具韌性，債務軌跡及缺乏EBITDA數據以計算槓桿，值得密切監察再融資及資本配置。
